visual.description: Race chart animation accelerates through 2021–2022. COVID annotation fades out. 2021: lines recover from the dip, mostly normalizing. 2022: dramatic upward movement. ALL lines rise visibly. Eggs (Muted Pink) spike sharply — from ~1.05 to ~1.71. Event marker at 2022: 'Inflation Surge + Avian Flu' in Muted Red text. The upward movement of all lines should feel urgent — faster animation than previous years. A subtle red tint washes over the chart background (5% opacity) as lines cross above 1.0. The 'moving UP' moment should synchronize with arrows appearing next to each line.

notes: This is the storm scene. The animation speed should notably increase compared to the 'quiet decade' — convey urgency. The red tint on the chart background is subtle but effective. Eggs shooting from ~1.0 to ~1.7 in a single year should be the most dramatic line movement in the video so far. The event marker should be larger than previous ones — this is a major event. Use 30-frame animation for the 2022 surge.
